baseline_repeat.note: Same seeded recipe does not reproduce bit for bit across the environment restart/CPU execution. Hard-max selection can amplify small floating-point differences; no claim that the cause is proven. The three new arms run together in the same process.

density_only_control.description: A single scalar: mean of all pixels over all sampled contexts in a recording. No frequency positions, harmonic relationships or temporal order. Train-only scaler and balanced logistic regression C1, no selection or threshold tuning.

scope: Existing train/development sampled bags only, no new alarm calibration or independent assessment
